propositions: Whitespace-only edits to no_file_impact_reason produce different material fingerprints and incorrectly invalidate signed attestations as stale-material
material_basis() inserts no_file_impact_reason raw (not normalized) when file_impact_scope is none, while the description is canonicalized, violating the documented invariant

The normalize_reason parameter must be threaded through material_basis, material_fingerprint, and current_material_fingerprint_impl to normalize insignificant whitespace in reasons for current fingerprints

Legacy attestations from three historical generations (pre-330c raw/raw, post-330c/pre-2be7 normalized/raw, post-2be7/pre-fix normalized/raw) must continue matching their original fingerprints via explicit normalize_reason=False in _legacy_material_ok
